channel.title: SupaWhisper Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
New: local transcription

  • Phonon-2 runs on your Mac. Choose it in Settings → Engine to dictate without an internet connection or a Deepgram key. The model is a one-time 187 MB download.
  • Local mode is English only and doesn't format numbers or dates yet.
  • Settings now has Engine, Cloud API and Local Model tabs.

Fixes

  • Updates now come from https://kmhari.github.io/supa-whisper/appcast.xml.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
SupaWhisper 1.0.4

  • Deepgram Nova-3: transcription now uses Deepgram's newest general-purpose model.
  • Mic turns off between dictations: the microphone runs only while you're recording. The orange mic indicator goes away when you stop, and Bluetooth headsets return to full audio quality.
